title: Seated forward fold

steps.text: Sit on the mat with your legs straight in front of you.
steps.cue: Sit with your legs straight in front of you.

steps.text: Bend your knees a little and sit up tall on your sitting bones.
Fold forward from your hips and rest your hands wherever they reach.
steps.cue: Fold from your hips. Hands wherever they reach.

steps.text: Keep your neck long and breathe slowly.
Come up slowly, one bit at a time.
steps.cue: Come up slowly, a bit at a time.

mistakes: Rounding the back to reach the feet.
regression: Sit on a folded blanket and bend your knees more.
stopIf: Come up if you feel pain in your lower back or behind your knees.

anatomy.why: Tipping forward from the hips lengthens the back of the thighs.
